title: Work lifecycle · owner acceptance
boundary: A privacy-minimized projection of the committed owner-acceptance tape. Original state IDs, verdicts, and law IDs are retained. Actor IDs and deployment counters are omitted. Event arguments are not supplied by the replay artifact. This is not live execution, authorization, or verified deployment.

steps.note: The stored projection moves from Proposed to Claimed.
The stored projection moves from Claimed to Implementing.
An accepted event can leave the state constructor unchanged.
The stored projection moves from Implementing to Verifying.
The stored projection moves from Verifying to DraftPR.
The event is refused. The recorded state remains DraftPR. The replay artifact does not contain the event arguments.
The stored projection moves from DraftPR to Integrated. This is an abstract fixture, not a deployment receipt.
The abstract state is Deployed. This browser does not observe any running system.
The event is refused. The recorded state remains Deployed.
This result is held, not refused or accepted. The recorded state remains Deployed.
The abstract fixture reaches Accepted. A replay is not a fresh owner approval.
The stored projection reaches Merged. No repository mutation occurs in this page.
